about: Literal back-translation of src/episode/dev/fixtures/engine-demo/storyboard.es.json, made 2026-11-24 by a Claude session (wave 3) for the proof run. NOT blind: this session had read the English storyboard before back-translating. Each item keeps the Spanish text it was made from, so a later change to the fixture shows up as stale instead of being compared silently.

title.text: POV: Te vuelves un caller famoso (fixture de demostración)
title.bt: POV: You become a famous caller (demonstration fixture)

s01.narration.text: Publicas un solo gráfico. Diez mil desconocidos compran tu moneda en menos de una hora.
s01.narration.bt: You publish a single chart. Ten thousand strangers buy your coin in less than an hour.

s01.onScreen.subtitle.text: Una historia ficticia sobre un patrón muy real.
s01.onScreen.subtitle.bt: A fictional story about a very real pattern.

s02.narration.text: Así funciona el juego. Primero, compras temprano y en silencio. Luego publicas la señal para tus seguidores. Ellos compran, el precio salta y tú vendes mientras ellos compran. [src:demo-pattern]
s02.narration.bt: This is how the game works. First, you buy early and in silence. Then you publish the signal/call for your followers. They buy, the price jumps and you sell while they buy. [src:demo-pattern]

s03.narration.text: En el gráfico se ve así. Un lanzamiento lento, un bombeo repentino cuando publicas, y luego el suelo desaparece.
s03.narration.bt: On the chart it looks like this. A slow launch, a sudden pumping when you publish, and then the floor disappears.

s04.narration.text: Así que antes de seguir a cualquier caller, haz tres cosas. Revisa quién compró antes de la publicación. Revisa qué tan rápido vendieron. Y nunca compres la vela de la que todos están gritando.
s04.narration.bt: So before following any caller, do three things. Review/check who bought before the publication/post. Review/check how fast they sold. And never buy the candle that everyone is shouting about.

s04.onScreen.title.text: Antes de seguir a un caller

s04.onScreen.steps.0.text: Revisa quién compró antes de la publicación
s04.onScreen.steps.0.bt: Check who bought before the publication

s04.onScreen.steps.2.text: Nunca compres la vela que todos gritan
s04.onScreen.steps.2.bt: Never buy the candle that everyone shouts

s05.narration.text: Como dijo un caller: Nadie revisa la billetera. Todos revisan el gráfico.
s05.narration.bt: As a caller said: Nobody checks the wallet. Everyone checks the chart.

s05.onScreen.quote.text: Nadie revisa la billetera. Todos revisan el gráfico.
s05.onScreen.quote.bt: Nobody checks the wallet. Everyone checks the chart.

s06.narration.text: Si esto te salvó de una mala operación, suscríbete. Badger vigila los gráficos para que tú no tengas que hacerlo.
s06.narration.bt: If this saved you from a bad trade/operation, subscribe. Badger watches the charts so that you don't have to do it.

s06.onScreen.title.text: Evitar una sola mala operación ya vale la pena
s06.onScreen.title.bt: Avoiding a single bad trade/operation is already worth it

s07.narration.text: La próxima vez: construyes un agente de trading con IA. ¿Qué podría salir mal?
s07.narration.bt: Next time: you build a trading agent with AI. What could go wrong?

s07.onScreen.title.text: Próximo: construyes un agente de trading con IA
